meta: Your first 30 days at work: AI helps you learn the job fast, but pasting company documents by mistake costs you trust.

muc.title: Learn fast, don't leak
muc.text: In your first thirty days, AI helps you learn the job very fast, but pasting company documents by mistake costs you trust.

muc.title: Ask in week one
muc.text: In week one, ask your manager which AI tools the company allows and which data must never leave.

muc.title: A notebook of new words
muc.text: When you meet unfamiliar jargon, ask AI to explain it with an example. Paste only the word, not internal emails.

muc.title: Rename before you ask
muc.text: To ask about a real situation, change the client and project names and remove internal numbers.

muc.title: A thirty-day plan
muc.text: Ask AI for a thirty-day learning plan for your role, split by week, without pasting company documents.
